drivers.name: ETC Eos Family Console
drivers.author: OpenAVC
drivers.description: Controls ETC Eos family lighting consoles (Apex, Ti, Gio, Ion Xe, Element 2, Nomad/Eos PC) via OSC. Fire cues, fire macros, recall snapshots and presets, fire palettes, set channel/group/submaster levels, send raw command-line strings, press hardkeys/softkeys. Status pushed by Eos: current/pending cue text, command line, Live/Blind state, active cue progress.

help.overview: Controls an ETC Eos family lighting console (Apex, Ti, Gio, Ion Xe, Element 2, Nomad, Eos PC) over OSC (Open Sound Control) via UDP. Fire cues, fire macros, recall snapshots and presets, fire palettes, set channel/group/submaster levels, send raw command-line strings, or press any hardkey/softkey. Eos pushes the current command line, active cue text, pending cue text, Live/Blind state, and active cue progress percentage automatically.
help.setup:
1. On the console: Setup > System > Show Control > OSC.
   Enable both OSC RX and OSC TX. Set OSC UDP RX to 8000 and OSC UDP
   TX to 8001 (or any pair you prefer, then mirror the values in
   this driver's config).
2. Set OSC TX IP to the OpenAVC server's IP address. Eos will send
   all /eos/out/... status to that address on the OSC TX port.
3. In OpenAVC: enter the console's IP address as Host. Leave Port
   at 8000 and Listen Port at 8001 unless you changed them on the
   console.
4. Hardkey names for the press_key command match the labels printed
   on the console face panel, in lowercase, with spaces replaced
   by underscores (e.g. "go", "stop", "go_to_cue", "live", "blind",
   "select_last", "clear_cmd_line"). The full list lives in the
   Eos Family Online Help under "OSC Key Names".

compatible_models.notes: All Eos-family consoles share the same OSC dictionary documented in the Eos Family Online Help. ColorSource AV exposes a subset of the same /eos OSC namespace.
